sample_unit: longitudinal simulations grounded in donated chatbot histories from 22 users

links.outcome: Timing and omission of support by a memory-equipped assistant in simulated multi-turn crisis conversations
links.effect: Advice was less aligned with readiness after a crisis than in matched controls, mainly from premature recommendations. Explicitly unproductive advice was rare, but clinician-expected support such as follow-up and next-step planning was frequently omitted.
links.quote: Although explicitly unproductive advice was rare, the assistant frequently omitted clinician-expected support such as follow-up and planning for next steps.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating timing and readiness-alignment of advice in longitudinal AI mental health support using a clinician-developed framework (CARE)

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance and longitudinal safety behavior (timing, omissions, memory) in simulated mental health conversations without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice comparison.
